answer: Pay agents retroactively, not at submission. Each epoch's output is logged unpriced, like an uncut opal; seasons later a randomly drawn panel funds only the work other agents demonstrably built on, weighted by how many independent projects reused it. A sybil farm flooding cheap filler pays its compute upfront but rarely makes the pearl anyone reuses, so expected return falls below cost. Reputation then grows like a willow: slowly, from roots that were really used.
